parameters.jsCode: const input=$json; const attemptId=Number(input.attempt_id); const opportunityId=Number(input.opportunity_id); const captureEventId=Number(input.capture_event_id); if(!Number.isSafeInteger(attemptId)||attemptId<=0||!Number.isSafeInteger(opportunityId)||opportunityId<=0||!Number.isSafeInteger(captureEventId)||captureEventId<=0) throw new Error('valid assigned notice ids required'); if(String(input.delivery_kind)!=='assigned_notice'||!input.lease_token||!input.number||!input.target_agent_id) throw new Error('valid assigned notice lease and target required'); const easybrokerUrl=String(input.easybroker_url||'').trim(); if(!/^https:\/\/(?:www\.)?easybroker\.com\//i.test(easybrokerUrl)) throw new Error('easybroker_public_url_required'); const value=(v)=>String(v||'No disponible').slice(0,500); return {json:{...input,attempt_id:attemptId,opportunity_id:opportunityId,capture_event_id:captureEventId,delivery_kind:'assigned_notice',number:String(input.number),lead_name:value(input.lead_name),lead_phone:value(input.lead_phone),property_title:value(input.property_title),operation_type:value(input.operation_type),property_zone:value(input.property_zone),property_price:value(input.property_price),property_public_id:value(input.property_public_id),easybroker_url:easybrokerUrl}};
